purpose: Independence check of the GSE10971 raw arrays against the retained GPL570 studies before adoption as the sixth ovarian client.

byte_level.method: Downloaded the GEO series RAW archives, decompressed every CEL.gz and compared SHA-256 of the decompressed CEL bytes.
byte_level.gpl96_note: GSE6008 and GSE26712 are HG-U133A arrays; their CEL files cannot be byte-identical to HG-U133 Plus 2.0 files.

intensity_level.method: Spearman correlation of raw log2 cell intensities on a fixed subsample of 60,000 cells across all HG-U133 Plus 2.0 arrays; GSE14407 arrays (known byte-identical copies of GSE38666 arrays) serve as the positive control.

selection: Controls: 12 FTEn arrays (GSM277776-GSM277787). HGSC: 11 arrays, one per patient, ovary-site array for patients 2 and 3 (GSM277800, GSM277803-GSM277812 except GSM277810/GSM277811 replace GSM277801/GSM277802). Excluded: 12 FTEb and GSM277801/GSM277802.
